units.spine: The Guild Council has standing in the town, and it spends that standing on decisions the town would refuse to anybody else.
The Guild Council's standing rests on the town's prosperity, and whatever else holds it up is small beside the trade.
A stranger with business at Spitzplatz needs one name and gets one answer, and the answer holds.
The quarrel over the market levies is named in the town and never explained.
Several houses of business at Spitzplatz keep books that nothing can be found wrong with, and that is the service they sell.
No one word in the town covers how the place is governed, and the hall cannot supply one either.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: The hall is given its proper title in public and a shorter name everywhere else, and both names are exact.
The seat the Guild Council holds is held because nothing in the town outweighs it, and that is put to the test again whenever somebody has cause.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public backing hardens the hold
units.spine: People here who would move on the Guild Council do not, because moving on a seat the town is behind costs more than the seat is worth.
